description: SolarTherm is the project's Modelica platform for concentrating solar thermal systems that produce electricity, fuels or industrial heat. It contains a library of receivers, storage, fluids, control strategies and system configurations, alongside parameter handling, simulation, surrogate-model and optimisation tools. Inputs define component choices and operating conditions; outputs support whole-system performance and economic comparisons. Spatial coverage is the configured plant and its weather context, while time resolution and horizon follow the experiment. Modelica source is available through GitHub free under LGPL-3.0, with OpenModelica installation and tutorial guidance. A limitation is that system-level component representations require suitable parameters and are not detailed designs of every device. The platform supports solar-generation and industrial-heat infrastructure studies. SolarPILOT (model-solarpilot) provides related concentrating-solar field modelling. The documentation lists published applications, but their input data and results were not reproduced here.
